# The proposal names a kind that is not in the runbook. The check refuses it before any approval: no role is paged for an approval, nothing is saved or written,
# the commander gets the case, and a person owns the incident.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec beehavereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

grep 'HANDOFF: the proposal is not valid: unknown mitigation kind delete_everything' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 primary$' pages.log
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 commander$' pages.log
! exists writes.log
! exists status.log
! exists home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/before.json

-- body.txt --
The watch.
